youtube.title: Sink or Float? 🛁 Easy Science Experiment for Kids | Toy Box Friends
youtube.description:
Will it sink or float? Robo, Duck, Frog and Pig run a bathtub lab. Guess with your thumbs, then watch the test: a ball, a spoon, an apple, a big beach ball, a little pebble, and an orange that floats in its peel and sinks without it. We guess, then we test!

Try it at home with a bowl of water and a grown-up right next to you, always: a plastic toy, a metal spoon, an apple, a leaf, a crayon and an orange. Sort them into float and sink, then test. A grown-up does the peeling. Never play near water alone, and wipe up spills.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for preschool.

do.text: Splash! Duck jumped in the water. Quack!
This is our lab! We guess, then we test.
Frog drops things in. Pig keeps score.
Two new words. Float and sink.
Float means it stays on top, like Duck. Thumbs up!
Sink means it goes down to the bottom.
Thumbs down for sink! Watch this pebble.
Down it goes. The pebble sinks.
Will it float or sink? What do you guess?
It floats! Bob, bob, up on top!
Float or sink? Show me your thumbs!
Test three. A big red apple.
Many friends think apples sink. What do you think?
An apple has air inside. Air helps it float.
Now a big, big beach ball!
I know! Big things sink. Little things float!
No, Robo! Big things can float!
Oops! We guess, then we test.
Last test. A round orange. Float or sink?
Now, a grown-up peels the orange.
The same orange, with no peel. Float or sink?
It floated before. So float! Quack!
The peel has tiny pockets of air, like a life jacket!
Same fruit, two answers. So we test!
My feathers hold lots of air!
And I put oil on my feathers. It keeps the water off!
Ducks get that oil from near their tail.
Float like Duck! Arms out. Sway, sway.
Lab quiz! One. A rubber toy duck. Float or sink?
Two. A spoon. Float or sink?
Three. The big beach ball. Float or sink?
Four. The peeled orange. Float or sink?
Sink! No peel, no life jacket.
Pig counts four right! You are super scientists!
Bob, bob, up on top! Down, down, down. Plop!
Try it at home, with a grown-up. Always!
We guess, then we test. Bye-bye!
